# The OP-1's controls, screen by screen

<!-- Generated by the kit's source repository (controls_map); do not edit by hand. -->

What the OP-1 itself does with each key and each encoder on each of its screens, and what is free there.
Look here before you write a `uses` line (manifest.md, "Controls"): a control the table calls free needs
no extra word; one the OP-1 uses can only be taken on purpose, with the word `over`, and then your
plugin replaces what the OP-1 does there. The same table is inside Opus: a plugin built for core 2.67 or
later that takes a used control without `over` is refused when it loads, and the mods list's controls
page shows under each control what it replaces.

## Whose is which combination

| Combination | Whose | A plugin takes it |
|---|---|---|
| a key or an encoder's turn | the OP-1's | on its own page (`modal`), or with `over` on purpose |
| shift + a key or a turn | the OP-1's second layer | where the tables below call it free |
| FN + a key or a turn | the plugins' layer | everywhere (`fn`) |
| FN held alone | one overlay at a time | `fn_hold` |
| an encoder's push | the page's own | on its own page; free on most of the OP-1's screens |
| FN + a push | the tools' layer | on every page |

FN is the help key. Opus keeps it as a modifier, so it is no input of its own, and neither is shift.
Two plugins never share a control: the second one to load is refused, and the mods list names the first.

## The screens

Each screen has a row for plain controls and one for controls with shift held. "Free" lists every input
the OP-1 does nothing with there. The inputs are named as a `uses` line names them.

### synth t1

In a `uses` line: `synth t1`.

|---|---|---|

### tape

In a `uses` line: `tape`.

| | The OP-1 uses | Free |

## What Opus itself takes

Opus's menu, on every screen:

| Control | Where | What |
|---|---|---|
| `synth` + `drum` + `tape` + `mixer` together | every screen | opens the menu (the OS would start the helicopter game) |
| every key | while the menu is open | while the menu is open: t1-t3 the categories, help the about page, left back; a mode key closes it |
| every turn | while the menu is open | blue moves the selection; green, white and orange change the row's settings (colours: green the theme; cleaner: green asks for it) |
| every push | while the menu is open | blue opens a row's page (the colour picker); orange on the colours row saves the colours as a theme; white on a plugin asks to delete it (t1-t4 held together deletes, white again cancels); the cleaner's page: white asks again for its row's job (t1-t4 together, white cancels) |

## What Opus's own plugins take

Their `uses` lines as their manifests have them. A `modal` line counts only while that plugin's own page
is open, so it never clashes with yours.

| Plugin | Control | What |
|---|---|---|
| Bend | `left shift over` | bends down, or octave down |
| Bend | `right shift over` | bends up, or octave up |
| Bend | `left noshift synth over` | bends down (arrows: bend) |
| Bend | `right noshift synth over` | bends up (arrows: bend) |
| Bend | `left noshift list over` | bends down in a list |
| Bend | `right noshift list over` | bends up in a list |
| Bend | `white_turn shift synth modal` | bend curve / up depth |
| Bend | `orange_turn shift synth modal` | bend speed / down depth |
| Bend | `white_push shift synth modal` | swaps its row |
| Bend | `orange_push shift synth modal` | swaps its row |
| Bend | `white_push shift synth modal` | swap curve / up depth |
| Bend | `orange_push shift synth modal` | swap speed / down depth |
| Dice | `white_push shift synth` | roll the dice |
| Dice | `orange_push shift synth` | undo the last roll |
| DX | `blue_turn synth modal` | the voice, on its page |
| DX | `green_turn synth modal` | the part, on its page |
| DX | `white_turn synth modal` | the parameter, on its page |
| DX | `white_turn shift synth modal` | the next section |
| DX | `orange_turn synth modal` | the value, on its page |
| DX | `orange_turn shift synth modal` | the value, ten at a time |
| DX | `t4 synth modal` | on T4: the LFO stays dx's |
| DX | `blue_turn fn synth modal` | T2 peak, T4 wave |
| DX | `green_turn fn synth modal` | T2 hold, T4 sensitivity |
| DX | `white_turn fn synth modal` | T4 key sync |
| monitor | `fn_hold` | the figures |
| Outatime | `blue_turn shift synth t1` | spread: the arms detune |
| Outatime | `green_turn shift synth t1` | tone |
| Outatime | `white_turn shift synth t1` | flux: the ensemble |
| Outatime | `orange_turn shift synth t1` | the overdrive type |
| Fx overdrive | `green_turn t3 modal` | fx 2, in the effect list |
| Fx overdrive | `blue_push synth t3` | on T3: fx 1 or fx 2 |
| Fx overdrive | `blue_push drum t3` | on T3: fx 1 or fx 2 |
| Fx overdrive | `blue_push mixer t3` | on T3: fx 1 or fx 2 |
| Play as pause | `play noshift over` | pause while the tape plays |
| Play as pause | `stop noshift over` | to the start, playing on |
| Preset tools | `orange_push modal` | name a saved preset |
| Preset tools | `blue_turn modal` | naming: a letter |
| Preset tools | `green_turn modal` | naming: a digit |
| Preset tools | `white_turn modal` | naming: a symbol |
| Preset tools | `orange_turn modal` | naming: backspace |
| Preset tools | `white_push shift modal` | delete a saved preset |
| Scales and chords | `blue_push synth t1` | on T1: the scales page |
| Scales and chords | `green_push synth t1` | on T1: the chords page |
| Stock help | `fn_hold` | the os's help |
| Tape undo | `left noshift tape with tape` | undo |
| Tape undo | `right noshift tape with tape` | redo |
| Zoom | `white_turn shift tape over` | zoom the tape view |
